other_notes: Program was 6 years for entrants <=2010 (Jackson, Josiah finished as PGY-6 chiefs; 2012 site says six-year program) and 7 years from the 2011 entrant (2013 site: seven-year). Complement 1/year until 2024 expansion to 2/year (history page), though 2 PGY-1s appear in 2022-23 (Korst, Thakur). Vishal Thakur (MCh) jumped PGY-2 (2023-24) -> PGY-4 (2024-25). Erica Johnson (2023-24, 2024-25) = Erica Webster (2026-27): same directory ID 84972; canonicalised to Erica Webster. Roy Hwang missing from 2017-18 list though alumni page gives graduation 2018 (likely out-of-program PGY-7). Alumni graduation rows inserted into training_history: Hwang 2018, Singh 2019, Cheyuo 2021, Katsevman 2021, Rehman 2023, Lawrence 2024 (recent-graduates page) and Jackson 2015, Josiah 2016 (2016 former-residents page, no year given; year inferred from last roster). PHASE 2: WVU HSC Directory Neurosurgery department list (directory.hsc.wvu.edu/Department/1803) turned out to be an archived per-year roster (2010, 2012, 2017, 2019-2026). Arsanious's directory title went from PGY-3 to PGY-2 in early 2021 before he left. Thakur was a stereotactic/functional fellow in 2021-22 before entering as PGY-1 in 2022-23.
